note: This file is written before any holdout computation in this session. Design parameters below are not to be changed after the first HOLDOUT-DTI is computed; any change must be recorded as a deviation in the run card and the irregularity ledger.

evaluator.name: gemsdoe54-segment-cv
evaluator.units: 8-connected components of the catalogue raster (whole segments)
evaluator.visible_masking: pixel-exact: scored area = footprint minus visible catalogue minus collar
evaluator.catalogue_exclusion_rule: candidate cells within 3 px (300 m) of VISIBLE catalogue only, in every fold
evaluator.metric: pooled DTI, alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel (kernel_px 3.0)
evaluator.uncertainty: paired whole-segment cluster bootstrap, B = 1000, stratified by fold; percentile 95% CI
evaluator.cross_check: fold 0 decomposed metric must agree with gemsdoe54.holdout.pooled_metric to 1e-6
evaluator.canary: single-feature AUC on withheld cells per fold; AUC > 0.90 = LEAKAGE
evaluator.null: torus-shift of each candidate's dots within the scored area, N = 20 per fold

C0_random_admissible_control.definition: uniform random admissible cells, count-matched to C1 per fold, same exclusion E_k

C1_endpoint_continuation.surface: src/gemsdoe54/continuation.py:endpoint_continuation_surface(visible_catalogue, footprint) with library defaults (min_component_cells=8, min_elongation=8.0, local_tail_fraction=0.2, start_extension_px=3.25, max_extension_px=15.0), zeroed within 3 px of VISIBLE catalogue and outside the scored area
C1_endpoint_continuation.emission: shared builder rules: linearity gate (min_px=3, min_px_extent=5, min_elongation=6.0) then emit_spaced_dots spacing_px=2.0, priority = surface + 1e-3 * distance-from-visible
C1_endpoint_continuation.mechanism: mapped strands continue beneath range-front cover; tangent projection is the null model for the concealed continuation
C1_endpoint_continuation.non_fault_mimic: lithologic contacts, intrusive margins, erosional endpoints, map-sheet edges

C2_manifest_radedge.surface: top-decile gradient magnitude of [K, Th, U, TC, ThK, UK, UTh, TMI_up150] (geodawn_rad_u8.tif sha256 c22420f75999030d7cc65c9e31e50d232ea6158423bca051613a18a8b20ba682, geodawn_extensions_u8.tif sha256 a35a9c6d2a14786f4dab85481ee59769213072f5dab5b2535ea82ae4d9bb7d9b) restricted to a 2 km Euclidean halo of M = (Q vents+flows) union (paleo sinter/tufa) union (2 m probes) (derived_gdr_volcanics c219bd644e6f7a4071dc429e29b909a2296967b0657bf456bb6675413ee76cb2, derived_gdr_paleo d6a3609bd7943fa5f1126a3cc688441aeceee261a76cd6a90a206830400066a4, derived_gdr_2m_probes 7ac3cfdf2412f7f8a8b82d928115888c510f106f0254fb0b3988448db2f3b6ec); score = grad_norm * exp(-dM_px / 10); zeroed within 3 px of VISIBLE catalogue and outside the scored area
C2_manifest_radedge.emission: same shared builder rules as C1
C2_manifest_radedge.mechanism: hydrothermal alteration (K depletion core / K enrichment halo) marks permeable structure; vents, sinter and thermal ground say the system is active
C2_manifest_radedge.non_fault_mimic: lava-flow inflation fronts, alluvial K lows, reworked sinter

selection_rule.for_the_submission_build: build the candidate with the higher pooled HOLDOUT-DTI; exact tie -> fewer dots
selection_rule.slot_policy: a weekly slot is recommended only if the selected candidate's HOLDOUT-DTI exceeds the incumbent holdout best 0.0483 (C1_sgmc_complement, 2026-10-08 receipt) with a paired 95% CI on the difference excluding 0; promotion to a real slot remains a separate selector decision

build_rules.full_data_mode: features derived from the FULL published catalogue (that is what the organizer gives at inference); exclusion = cells within 3 px of the full catalogue
build_rules.output: single-band float32 GeoTIFF, EPSG:32611, 3730 x 3292, 100 m transform (100, 0, 243350, 0, -100, 4508550), values exactly {0.0, 1.0}, ALL FINITE including outside the footprint (zeros outside)
build_rules.why_all_finite: the submission form rejected a file with the message 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' (user-reported 2026-10); the highest owner-reported artefact (0.2778) is a '-zeros' file; NaN-outside twins have also been board-observed to score, so the all-finite variant is the strictly safer envelope

budget.E1: shared holdout run for C0/C1/C2 with canaries, nulls, bootstrap CIs, detection floor
budget.E2: full-data build of the selected candidate + pre-placement surface lane screen + final-dot lane screen + format validator
budget.E3: reserve (used only for a documented fix-and-rerun)

lane_gate.rule: abs Spearman <= 0.90 vs every registry raster; fraction of candidate dots within 3 px of ONE registry raster's dots <= 0.70
lane_gate.degenerate_exemption: a registry raster whose 3 px neighbourhoods cover >= 50% of footprint cells cannot discriminate overlap (any raster passes/fails with it); it is excluded from the OVERLAP verdict but not from the rank-correlation verdict. Literal statistics are reported alongside. This reconciles validate_submission.py with sibling_uniqueness.py (IR-54-050).
registries: all grid-aligned submission-like rasters in the 63 GEMSDOE-family sibling repositories (1232 raster-like files inventoried 2026-10-09)
lane_gate.checks: before placement (on the thresholded score surface) AND on the final dots

power.framework: Cohen 1988 standardized-effect power analysis with paired whole-segment units
power.report: MDE at 80% power (two-sided alpha 0.05) for every paired comparison, before interpreting any difference
power.known_floor_2026_10_08: A-B MDE 0.0022, A-C MDE 0.0015 on ridge variants; segment-fragment floors 0.0045-0.0095 raw
